The report associates the device with earlier attacks and protests against the Rockefeller Mission, and records a subsequent review of U.S. security measures in Brazil’s Northeast, informed by a fact-finding visit on June 11–12. The material reflects U.S. diplomatic monitoring of political unrest and threats to American information facilities during the military government, when security concerns intersected with protest activity and opposition to U.S. involvement in Brazil.

N23812968.raw_response: {"core_themes": "This folder contains laws and regulations concerning Brazil’s internal security and counter-insurgency, with particular attention to measures controlling or banning the Communist Party.
